column1: # WHAT THE PARTY OWNS -- append-only. QUANTITIES ARE DERIVED: `tools/inventory.py`.
# Replaces the hand-edited `qty` column of campaign/inventory.tsv, which was the
# ONE campaign file still edited in place and the one that had rotted five times
# -- the carts (forty days), the mules, the small goods (357 gp, seventeen days),
# six ropes (eleven days), the dragon scales.
# *** WHY THERE IS A `unit` COLUMN -- the player's design, and it is the point ***
# The old `qty` cell was PROSE PRETENDING TO BE A NUMBER, and every tool that
# read it took the first integer it could find. Three of those reads were simply
# wrong and two more hid a fact somebody would have wanted:
#     "~2.5 IRON + 8 STANDARD"   read as 2    <- two things in one cell
#     "1,072 gp 1 sp"            read as 1
#     "~100 lb, ~97 gp"          read as 100  <- a WEIGHT read as a COUNT
#     "18 sealed (+1 broached)"  read as 18   <- the broached flask invisible
#     "8 (7 sound, 1 damaged)"   read as 8    <- and the damaged rope is the
#                                                one that nearly dropped Blartho
# ONE ROW PER (asset, condition), AND THE UNIT IS WHAT FORCES THE SPLIT. You
# cannot write "2.5 person-weeks of iron and 8 of standard" into one qty.
# *** WHAT IS *NOT* IN HERE, AND MUST NOT BE ***
#   LIGHT SOURCES AND FUEL belong to campaign/light.tsv and tools/light.py.
#   Lanterns, oil flasks, torches and candles were counted in BOTH places and
#   the two drifted apart TWICE -- light.py's disagreement warning caught it
#   both times. Two sources for one fact is the defect this project exists to
#   remove, so the second one is gone.
#   WHERE A THING IS IN THE DUNGEON belongs to campaign/world_changes.tsv.
#   This file records what the party OWNS; `world.py deployed` records what is
#   emplaced. SPIKES CARRIED = owned - emplaced, derived, never stored.
# verb: `anchor` sets the (asset, condition) total outright; `move` adds qty,
# which may be negative. Same shape as hp_log.tsv and money.tsv.
# Seeded 2026-09-11 at day 77 from inventory.tsv. Anchors rather than a
# reconstructed history, for the same reason money.tsv anchors at day 39: the
# old cells record a STATE and not the movements that produced it, and inventing
# the movements would put false precision into an append-only log.
# *** `holder` IS RETIRED AS OF DAY 103 -- READ ONLY. ***
# The player: "let's have carry.tsv become the single where is everything."
# This column was free text, ONE STRING PER ROW, and thirty-three distinct
# hand-typed values were in use -- "WORN: Dave, Torsat, Yrtone, Blartho",
# "15 FRYTHON, 15 Ista", "spread". campaign/carry.tsv now answers WHERE a
# thing is, closed to character names plus people.tsv/places.tsv ids, and
# `carry.py check` demands its total for every owned thing equal what this
# file says is owned. What is written in `holder` below this point is a
# historical note about who a row's writer believed held a thing AT THE TIME
# -- it is not authoritative and new rows need not fill it in.

Banded mail alone would be AC 4; with the shield, AC 3; her DEX makes it AC 6. *** SO SHE WEARS MAIL AND CARRIES A SHIELD AND IS STILL THREE WORSE THAN HASK IN THE IDENTICAL KIT.
